_why: 2026-11-03. The first paying customer recorded ~4 hours of a healthcare careers course on desktop 1.0.8 and got zero terms: verifyTerm rejected every candidate, Alzheimer and the course's regulator abbreviations included. precision-candidates.json is all science, economics and computing, so it never caught this. These sentences are written for the test, not taken from anyone's lecture. NONSTEM_TECH: the candidate deserves a card. NONSTEM_MUNDANE: the candidate is an everyday word the extractor really does propose in such courses, and must not get one.
